equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed 
every six month as 
indicated by M6 in the above title block.

The 
soot blower used for cleaning superheater, reheater, economizer tubes, and 
regenerative air heater baskets.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, reviewed 
by directed by eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil 
at edec, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-salam, approved by eng: 
Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPCo. inspection and quality 
control head sector

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 soot blower

Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor 
 of this soot blower
The soot blower must be isolated mechanically
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Suitable lifting device. Feeler gauge

Hammer,
 Air wrench
Check the gear box oil level and adjuste as required
Check the lube oil leakage
Check the soot blower for smooth operation
Check all bolts and support steel fasteners bolts, and tighten if necessary
Check the bearing oil for contamination
Check the soot blower holes tip
Check the poppet valve seat and link
Check the seal air lines
Check the lance tube for deformation
Check and inspect the air relief valve
Check the roller and carriage
Inspect and analyse the oil of the gear box

Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed 
every six month as 
indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The 
soot blower used for cleaning superheater, reheater, economizer tubes, and 
regenerative air heater baskets.
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, reviewed 
by directed by eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil 
at edec, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-salam, approved by eng: 
Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPCo. inspection and quality 
control head sector
Technical Specification
Item | Soot Blower
No. of soot blowers | 22 for each boiler
Soot blower type | 1. Retractable
 2. Semi-Retractable
Manufacture | Diamond - USA
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this 
 soot blower
Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor 
 of this soot blower
The soot blower must be isolated mechanically
Tools and Equipment
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Suitable lifting device. Feeler gauge
Hammer,
 Air wrench
Work to be Carried Out
Monthly
Check the gear box oil level and adjuste as required
Check the lube oil leakage
Check the soot blower for smooth operation
Check all bolts and support steel fasteners bolts, and tighten if necessary
Check the bearing oil for contamination
Check the soot blower holes tip
Check the poppet valve seat and link
Check the seal air lines
Check the lance tube for deformation
Check and inspect the air relief valve
Check the roller and carriage
Inspect and analyse the oil of the gear box
